notes:
Lead source: inbound from support automation meetup + self-serve signup. Small SMB (support platform for mid-market e-commerce brands). Primary objective: reduce agent handle time via automated ticket summarization and structured triage. Wants tool-calling so LLM can: 1) create/update Zendesk tickets, 2) call internal microservices to fetch order status, 3) attach suggested replies. Needs structured JSON outputs for ticket fields (category, intent, priority, estimated SLA) to feed into workflows.

Key requirements / quotes:
- "We need verbatim summaries for agents, not long-winded AI prose. 2-3 bullet TL;DR."
- Latency target: p95 <= 200ms for single-turn ticket summarize endpoint; throughput target ~15 qps during peak.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB margins; leaning on smallest viable model + batching. Wants ability to route to cheaper model for non-critical tasks.

Technical notes:
- Integrations: Zendesk + HubSpot + internal order API; currently sending raw email threads to summarizer; attachments (pdfs) cause failures.
- Asked about streaming responses and function/tool calling for immediate suggestion UX.
- Preference: hosted API (public cloud) for now — no VPC requirement; may revisit Dedicated if usage spikes.

POC plan: 30-day trial, sample prompt set (we provide), 5k test messages, verify latency + summary quality on 1000 real tickets. Deliverables: POC scripts, quickstart repo, example structured-output schema, minimal cost forecast.

Next comms: AE (Jordan) to send pricing + POC docs; SE (Priya) to run technical deep-dive; schedule week of 03/15. Procurement expects SOC2 docs and a two-week extended trial if quality metrics met.
